question: Should `meta` be a permanent opaque forward-compatible namespace for arbitrary runtime bookkeeping keys, rather than a strictly typed public configuration object?
rationale: The code correctly implements the proposed exception, but the repository policy treats config-shape changes and compatibility fallbacks as maintainer-owned product contracts; source and related migration evidence do not establish that this broad exception has already been approved.

options.title: Approve opaque metadata
options.body: Declare unknown `meta` children non-operational and forward-compatible, then require final-head live `loadConfig()` proof before merge.

options.title: Keep metadata strict
options.body: Reject the catchall and add future bookkeeping fields as typed, versioned metadata with doctor-owned migration when compatibility is needed.

recommendation.title: Approve opaque metadata
recommendation.body: Declare unknown `meta` children non-operational and forward-compatible, then require final-head live `loadConfig()` proof before merge.
